title: Concrete Pump Wear Parts: Replacement Interval from Photos, Not Invented Hours
seoTitle: Concrete Pump Wear Parts Replacement Interval | Pinjin Xingtai
description: Alibaba listings often quote 250–500 h wear-part intervals; that is not a Pinjin factory cell. ACPA: replace hose at the first broken braid; inspect S-valve, pistons and gaskets. Photograph OD and send the model slug. This is not a rewrite of the spare-parts structure article.

relatedPaths.label: Concrete pump spare parts and wear parts

answerBlock.what: Marketplace pages often print 250–500 operating hours for wear kits. That is Alibaba observation, not a Hebei Pinjin factory interval. ACPA: replace a delivery hose at the first broken braid; inspect the S-tube, pistons, cutting ring and gaskets; never wait for a burst. Pinjin lists [S-valve](/products/concrete-pump-s-tube-seal/), [piston](/products/concrete-pump-split-piston/), [carbide spectacles](/products/carbide-spectacles-plate/), [rubber hose](/products/concrete-pump-delivery-hose/) and [DN80 clamp](/products/concrete-pump-pipe-clamp-dn80/). We quote those SKUs from photos of OD and the pump model. We do not print a factory hour table. This page is not a second spare-parts structure list.
answerBlock.who: Operators who already know which part names are on the Pinjin parts hub and need the interval rule: photos + ACPA braid/gasket checks, not a copied 300-hour claim.
factors: Alibaba 250–500 h is observation, not a Pinjin cell
ACPA: hose to first broken braid; inspect S-valve, piston, gasket
Quote from OD photos and the pump model slug
No invented warranty hours or ‘OEM life’ numbers

faqs.question: Does Pinjin guarantee 300 hours on an S-valve?
faqs.answer: No hour guarantee is printed. The S-valve page is a parts SKU, not a life table. ACPA: inspect the S-tube and cutting ring; replace when worn or leaking. Photograph the valve and send the pump model. Marketplace 250–500 h claims are not Xingtai specs.

faqs.question: When should I replace a Pinjin rubber hose?
faqs.answer: ACPA: at the first broken braid, or sooner if the cover is cut to the reinforcement. Pinjin quotes hose after ID, length and working pressure — not after an unpublished hour count. See the hose vs steel article for line type, and this page for the braid rule.

faqs.question: Is this the same as the spare-parts list article?
faqs.answer: No. That article maps which SKUs exist (S-valve, piston, spectacles, clamp, pipe, hose). This page is only how we will not invent hours, and which ACPA inspect/replace cues we will cite. Do not duplicate the SKU table here.
